entries.label: Melodia Crystal Cathedral V3: vault + rose + collision + corridor LOD fog
entries.notes: V3 converges V1's Gate 2 verified cathedral with V2's authored corridor by IMPORTING both builders: v2.build_cathedral is call-for-call identical to V1 (golden-asserted), corridor VEX + controls table come verbatim from V2, cathedral controls/helpers from V1. 4 outputs: OUT_Cathedral (0), OUT_Rose (1), OUT_Collision (2), OUT_Corridor (3, fog volume rastering the lowest LOD tier). Corridor fixes: sibling LOD tiers at 40/25/15% keep (a 5% bottom tier rounds to ZERO prims on the 36-prim default mesh), volume.type left at Float, empty group on thicken/bevel, OUT_Corridor outputidx 3, all parm sets via _set. chain_type + lod_count are inner BUILD-time config (baked by the builder), so 18 of 20 controls are promoted. Built via Saved/HDA_build/ + byte copy so rebuilds cannot drop network-bearing files into hda/backup/ (Gate 0 zone). Corridor bay placement along +Z is an art pass, not builder work.

expect.golden_source: Cathedral pins = melodia_crystal_cathedral's measured green cook (shared code path: v3 imports V2's build_cathedral, which is call-for-call identical to V1, and asserts all three counts in --verify). OUT_Corridor 1/1 and LOD tiers [14, 8, 5] measured on the 2026-10-06 v3 build; verify PASS.

entries.label: Melodia Stained Glass Window (frame + pane + tracery + came)
entries.notes: Proper stained-glass window: frame + glass pane + tracery (panel/geometric/intersecting) + chladni lead came. Based on room_shell.py window construction. Material roles: glass_pane, tracery_frame, tracery_panel/geometric/intersecting, lead_came. Per-room note hue via NOTE_HUE_TABLE. Material-level reactivity via existing writer only. Mirror: Content/HDA/MelodiaStainedGlassWindow_1.0.hda. Rebuilt 2026-10-21 (proper window, not cubes or disc). GATE 2 GREEN 2026-10-22 (CORRECTED - an earlier null test drove toward the defaults note=G/mode(3,4) and wrongly blamed the HDA; the module reads every parm via evalParm): driving AWAY from defaults (note=A, mode 5,6) changes OUT from 348/232 to 612/408. Pins hold at defaults.
Known CURRENT_STATE failure: the recipe validates only with exists_on_main:false. Cook fallback is Tools/Houdini/vdm_fabric_mountains/faraway_static_field.py (RGBA + hash pattern).

entries.notes: Registered 2026-10-21. Output0 carries s@unreal_output_name = SM_Poitou_AbbeyRuins. REPRODUCIBILITY CAVEAT: the .hda is committed but its builder is ignored by .gitignore 'Tools/*' - force-add the builder or the HDA cannot be rebuilt from git.
